evidence.quote: Bewerbung für Internationals 01.04. bis 15.08. via uni-assist
Ausländische und deutsche Studienbewerber_innen, die ihren Schulabschluss oder ihren Hochschulabschluss im Ausland erworben haben (Ausnahme: deutsche Auslandsschule) bewerben sich über uni-assist.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' for this programme; the Jade pages state only the general semester contribution (434,80 EUR) and no programme-specific tuition fee for non-EU students, so tuition is recorded as 0 with the programme-page quote. Duration: 7 semesters = 3.5 years (also 210 ECTS). Intakes: the programme page gives '01.04. bis 15.08.' for internationals without a year; the application-period page confirms this same window as the general rule for foreign school-leaving certificates and notes the winter semester is the intake ('Studienbeginn Wintersemester'); the deadline is treated as recurring 15 August, but the JSON date was reported without a year in the source. Application channel: Jade pages state that applicants whose school-leaving qualification was obtained abroad apply via uni-assist; the pages do not mention a separate VPD route, so de-uni-assist is used. Language: the programme is taught entirely in English, so no German proficiency requirement applies to this programme ('Ein Nachweis deutscher Sprachkenntnisse ist nicht erforderlich'), even though German courses are recommended. Documents: the list comes from the university's general page for international applicants applying via uni-assist; the transcript of records is covered by the '(Hoch-)Schulzeugnisse mit Notenübersichten' entry.

evidence.quote: To enrol in the programme, students must have a valid university entrance qualification and provide proof of English language proficiency at a B2 level (accepted certificates according to our Access Regulations).

note.fr: Vérifiez sur le site du programme la liste détaillée des certificats d'anglais acceptés (niveau B2 requis) prévue par les Access Regulations.
note.en: Check the programme website for the detailed list of accepted English certificates (B2 required) set out in the Access Regulations.

evidence.quote: You can find a more detailed list on the programme website.
